answer: Every payout waits 48 hours in a public queue — nothing moves early. A hollow queue would let one operator farm rewards through hundreds of fakes, so anyone can contest a receipt with a $25 bond and proof of copied work or shared funds. Evidence keeps a form strict as a sonnet: same fields, same order. An upheld contest pays the whistleblower from the attacker's locked earnings; a wrong flag burns $25. A farmer with 300 fakes at $4 a week risks $1,200 on one exposure, and one contest freezes the whole set. Clean agents stay anchored by uncontested payouts.
